pages.title: StudioZIO Mastering Suite — Free Mastering Plugin for macOS
pages.description: StudioZIO Mastering Suite 2.1.1: EQ, glue compression, mid/side width, saturation, true-peak limiting and delivery metering in one chain. AU, VST3, AAX and Standalone for macOS 11+.
headings: The whole master, one signal path.
The same master, before and after
A whole chain that agrees with itself
The limiter is a stage, not a switch
It tells you what it costs
pages.text: Master bus · Version 2.1.1 · The whole master, one signal path. · Tonal shaping, dynamics, stereo control and delivery metering in a single environment, so the gain structure stays in one place instead of drifting across a chain of windows. · Download for macOS See the modules AU · VST3 · AAX · Standalone AAX validated in Pro Tools macOS 11+ Notarized Hear it first · The same master, before and after · Two renders of one passage, switched instantly so the playhead never moves. Both are matched to −12 LUFS integrated, because at different levels the louder one always wins and the comparison tells you nothing. · Güvercinler · Mastering Suite 2.0.0 Real render · matched −12 LUFS Hear it Unmastered Mastered Output Unmastered Mastered “ Güvercinler ”, a StudioZIO production, rendered through Mastering Suite 2.0.0. Both files measure −12.0 LUFS integrated and peak at or below −1 dBTP, measured on these encodes rather than on the masters, so the numbers describe what you are actually hearing. The unmastered take needed 3 dB of gain to reach the target and a little limiting to hold the ceiling; the mastered take came down on gain alone. · The interface · Everything on one surface · The nine-stage signal path stays visible while each stage opens into a focused control surface. Loudness, true peak, stereo correlation and quality remain on screen throughout. · StudioZIO Mastering Suite 2.0.0 Real Standalone capture of the Output stage in Deliver mode; no interface mock-up. · The same window, running. Pink Match takes a twenty-second learn pass against a Hip-Hop target, counting up as it listens; then the amount is adjusted while the passage keeps playing. · Pink Match · learn pass and amount sweep Your browser cannot play this file. Download the capture (MP4, 62 seconds, 17.1 MB). · 62 seconds with sound, cropped to the plug-in’s own window. · The take keeps audio playing while Pink Match learns and its amount is adjusted. Live loudness, true-peak, gain-reduction and stereo meters stay visible throughout. · Architecture · Nine stages, one gain structure · Each stage reports what it is applying, and every stage shares the same metering reference. The plug-in puts them across the top of its window in the order the audio meets them, which is the order they are listed here. · Signal path in the order the audio takes M/S 0 % Sat Off Pink 60 % Glue −0.4 Max 0 % EQ 0.0 Clip −3.0 Limit −0.30 Out −14.3 01 M/S engine · Stereo width handled as mid and side rather than a blanket widener, with the centre left intact. · 02 Saturation · Drive staged before the ceiling, applied where the level is still under your control. · 03 Pink Match · Twenty seconds of listening against a target curve, then correction toward it by the amount you choose. · 04 Glue · Bus compression with a gain-reduction trace, so you can see how much the master is actually moving. · 05 Maximizer · Density built with an inflator rather than more limiting, so level arrives before the ceiling has to. · 06 Tone EQ · Broad tonal shaping with a curve that reads at a glance and stays clear of the header while you work. · 07 Clipper · A separate pre-clip section ahead of the limiter, oversampled where the non-linearity actually is. · 08 Limiter · True-peak limiting after the clipper, followed by Output delivery controls and metering. · 09 Output · Dither, word length and the delivered true peak, with a quality report of what leaves the chain. · What makes it different · A whole chain that agrees with itself · Nine stages that were designed together, oversampled where distortion is actually created, with the metering that judges them built into the same window. · Pink Match learns your material · Give it twenty seconds and it measures your spectral balance against a target curve, then corrects toward it by the amount you choose. A target is a slope plus anchored deviations from it, not a straight line — an EDM master wants energy at 50 Hz and less at 250 Hz, which no single slope can ask for. Match strength scales how much of the measured deviation is acted on, and the result is clamped, so a target can never be forced onto a source. · Targets · 8 CURVES · LEARN 20 s · MATCH 0 – 100% · Oversampled where it matters · Saturation, clipping and the limiter’s true-peak detector each run at their own rate. The limiter detector uses 16× reconstruction; the separate true-peak meters use 4× reconstruction to report signal levels. · Rates · SAT 4× · CLIP 16×/8× · TP DETECTOR 16× · TP METERS 4× · The limiter is a stage, not a switch · A separate pre-clip section ahead of it, then character, inflator, upward and transient controls, with stereo unlink set separately for transients and for sustain. Loudness is built, not applied. · Output · TRUE PEAK · CEILING −3.00 – 0.00 dBTP · True peak ceiling −0.30 dBTP L −0.3 R −0.3 Post-limiter, before dither. Red past the ceiling. It tells you what it costs · The figure is the sum of the stages you actually have engaged, rounded up rather than to nearest so it can never under-report by a sample, and it is published to the host the moment the plugin is prepared rather than after the first audio block. Delay compensation is exact from the start instead of once the host catches up — and the number is printed on the interface rather than left for you to discover. · Latency · 106 SAMPLES ON THE FACTORY PRESET · Specification · What ships · Formats · Audio Unit (AU) · VST3 · AAX · Standalone · Price · Free · Platform · macOS 11+ · Windows · No build planned · Architecture · Universal — Apple Silicon and Intel · Version · 2.1.1 · Signing · Developer ID signed · Notarization · Apple notarized · Every automatable control, with its range and default, is listed in the parameter reference . Installation, plug-in locations and uninstall are covered in the installation guide . Writing about the plug-in? pages.description: How to install StudioZIO Mastering Suite 2.1.1 on macOS: the signed and notarized .pkg, where the AU, VST3, AAX and Standalone formats are placed, what to do when a host does not list the plug-in, and how to uninstall.
headings: Three things that actually go wrong
The host does not list the plug-in
The AU shows up but the VST3 does not
macOS says the package cannot be verified
pages.text: Installation · Download, double-click, rescan. · StudioZIO Mastering Suite 2.1.1 installs from a signed, Apple-notarized macOS package. Six steps, no licence key, no account, and nothing to disable in Gatekeeper. · macOS 11+ AU · VST3 · AAX · Standalone Apple notarized Download installer Parameter reference Before you start · What the installer needs · Operating system · macOS 11 Big Sur or later · Architecture · Universal — Apple Silicon and Intel · Host · Any application that loads Audio Unit v2, VST3 or AAX · macOS only. There is no Windows or Linux build, and none is planned. · Six steps · Installing the package · Download the installer · Get StudioZIO-Mastering-Suite-2.1.1.pkg from the current signed and notarized release. It is free, there is no licence key and no account. · Check what you downloaded (optional) · In Terminal, run shasum -a 256 ~/Downloads/StudioZIO-Mastering-Suite-2.1.1.pkg and compare the result with the SHA-256 published on this page. They should match character for character. · Open the package · Double-click it. macOS checks the Developer ID signature and the notarization ticket before the installer window appears, so there is no Gatekeeper warning to click past and no need to right-click → Open. · Follow the installer · Accept the prompts and authenticate when macOS asks. The installer places the Audio Unit, the VST3 and the AAX plug-in in the standard macOS locations. · Restart your DAW · Quit the host completely and reopen it. Hosts scan for plug-ins at launch, so one that was already running will not see the new install. · Load it · The plug-in is filed under the manufacturer name StudioZIO : in an Audio Unit menu, StudioZIO › StudioZIO Mastering Suite ; in a VST3 browser, the same name inside the StudioZIO folder; and in Pro Tools under the StudioZIO category or EQ/Dynamics/Harmonics. · Provenance · The file you should have · Installer · StudioZIO-Mastering-Suite-2.1.1.pkg · Release record · current signed and notarized release · SHA-256 · b054098c4f6565e5e469efd41554425d468830a001c9d4c531e72ab8c50f4cf1 · Version 2.1.1, Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. That release page is the only place StudioZIO publishes this installer: a copy from anywhere else, or one whose checksum does not match, is not our build. · On disk · Where to look for it · Location · What is there · /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/ · The Audio Unit, as StudioZIO Mastering Suite.component · /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/ · The VST3, as StudioZIO Mastering Suite.vst3 · /Library/Application Support/Avid/Audio/Plug-Ins/ · The AAX, as StudioZIO Mastering Suite.aaxplugin · /Applications/ · The Standalone application, as StudioZIO Mastering Suite.app · macOS keeps a second, per-user copy of the two plug-in folders inside your home folder. If a component is not at the system path, look at ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/ as well — hosts scan both. · If something is missing · Three things that actually go wrong · The host does not list the plug-in · Almost always a stale scan. Quit the host, reopen it, and ask its plug-in manager to rescan — in Logic Pro that is Plug-in Manager under the Logic Pro menu, where you can select the entry and rescan it directly. Check the folders above first: if the file is not on disk, the installer did not finish. · The AU shows up but the VST3 does not · The two formats are scanned from different folders by different hosts. Confirm that your host is actually configured to scan /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/ , then rescan. Some hosts keep their own additional VST3 search paths. · macOS says the package cannot be verified · Do not bypass that warning. The official package is Developer ID signed and notarized, so macOS opens it without complaint; the message means the download is incomplete or the file did not come from the release page. Delete it, download again, and compare the SHA-256. · Removing it · Uninstall · Quit every audio application · A host that has the plug-in loaded will hold the files open and may rewrite its cache on quit. · Delete the four items · Remove StudioZIO Mastering Suite.component , StudioZIO Mastering Suite.vst3 , StudioZIO Mastering Suite.aaxplugin and StudioZIO Mastering Suite.app from the locations listed above — checking the per-user plug-in folders as well as the system ones. · Reopen the host and rescan · The entry disappears once the host rescans. If a greyed-out entry lingers in its plug-in manager, remove it there too, or log out and back in so macOS rebuilds its Audio Unit cache. · There is no separate uninstaller: removing those items and letting the host rescan is the whole process.

pages.text: Press kit · Everything you need to write about Mastering Suite · StudioZIO Mastering Suite 2.1.1 is a free mastering chain for macOS. This page is the whole kit: the facts, what is actually in the chain, images cleared for use, and a paragraph you can paste. Nothing here needs to be requested by email. · Free macOS 11+ AU · VST3 · AAX · Standalone Apple notarized Download the installer Product page There is no Windows or Linux build. If your readers are on Windows, this one is not for them — better to know that before you write it up. · The facts · Specification · Product · StudioZIO Mastering Suite · Version · 2.1.1, released 7 September 2026 · Price · Free. No account, no licence key, no iLok, no email registration. · Platform · macOS 11 or newer · Architecture · Universal — Apple Silicon and Intel · Formats · AUv2, VST3, AAX, Standalone · Windows / Linux · No build · Installer · Apple signed and notarized .pkg , 20.7 MB · SHA-256 · b054098c4f6565e5e469efd41554425d468830a001c9d4c531e72ab8c50f4cf1 · Parameters · 42 automatable, organized into 9 automation groups · Developer · StudioZIO — Mert Erkan, Istanbul · Press contact · www.studiozio.tech/contact/ · Full parameter reference, with every automatable parameter's type, range and default, is on the parameters page . Installation and troubleshooting are on the install page . · What it is · Nine stages on one gain structure · M/S engine · Body, Clarity and Focus processing. · Saturation · 4x oversampled with antiderivative anti-aliasing (ADAA); "Warm Energy" and gradual-onset "Hot Tape" characters. · Pink Match · Spectral matching with a 20-second learn pass and adjustable target strength. · Glue · VCA compressor with a sidechain high-pass filter. · Maximizer · Density processing controlled by the Inflator amount. · Tone EQ · Three-band tone EQ. · Clipper · Soft or hard clipping ahead of the limiter. · Limiter · Lookahead true-peak limiter: release modes, upward compression, transient emphasis, stereo unlink, Delta audition, ceiling protection. · Output · Delivery word length, dither and output quality views. · Listed in the interface’s signal-path order. Persistent loudness, true-peak and stereo meters report the chain; they are not an additional processing stage. · Around the chain · Also on the interface · Metering · FFT spectrum, vectorscope, LUFS, sample peak and true peak remain available while working with the chain. · Gain Match · Level-matched A/B from the header, so the louder version does not win by being louder. · Delta audition · The limiter's DELTA switch plays only what is being removed. · If you are looking for an angle · The three things worth showing · Pink Match · Ten spectral bands, a 20-second learn pass, genre targets and an adjustable pink slope. It is visual and it happens fast, which makes it the easiest part to film. · EXPECTED TP · A ceiling-derived estimate: the requested ceiling minus the limiter’s fixed 0.01 dB detector reserve. A −1.00 dBTP ceiling reads ≈ −1.01 dBTP . This read-only estimate does not measure the audio or guarantee the delivered peak. It appears when the limiter and True Peak are enabled; use the output meters to read the signal. · Quality Check System · The QUALITY button scores what is actually coming out: an overall mark out of 100 with its own confidence figure, six weighted families, and every metric expanding to its value, why it matters and what to do. Estimates are labelled as estimates and genre-dependent figures are left unscored on purpose. EXPORT REPORT writes it out as text. · Here is the first one already filmed. Pink Match takes its twenty-second learn pass against a Hip-Hop target, then the amount is adjusted while the passage keeps playing. The file below is cleared for use in your piece, whole or in part. · Pink Match · learn pass and amount sweep Your browser cannot play this file. Download the capture (MP4, 62 seconds, 17.1 MB). · 62 seconds with sound, cropped to the plug-in’s own window. · The take keeps audio playing while Pink Match learns and its amount is adjusted. Live loudness, true-peak, gain-reduction and stereo meters stay visible throughout. · For the technical reviewer · Under the hood · The limiter’s true-peak detector uses 16x reconstruction with 512 taps per phase. The separate true-peak meters use 4x reconstruction with 16 taps per phase. Output delivery metering reports the signal after dither. Soft clip runs on a fixed 16x path with a smooth knee; hard clip is exact-threshold with polyBLAMP transition correction on a fixed 8x path. Oversampling is qualified per stage rather than chosen as one global factor. · Images and video · Cleared for use · Asset · Format · Size · File · Limiter stage — real Standalone capture · WebP · 1080 × 570 · mastering-suite-ui.webp · Output stage, Deliver mode — real Standalone capture · WebP · 1080 × 570 · mastering-suite-output.webp · Social / header card · PNG · 1200 × 630 · og-mastering-suite.png · Pink Match learn pass, with sound · MP4 · H.264 · AAC · 1440 × 760 · 62 s · 17.1 MB · pinkmatch-learn.mp4 · Poster frame for the video · WebP · 1440 × 760 · pinkmatch-learn-poster.webp · All four may be reproduced, cropped, resized, cut and re-encoded for coverage of this plug-in, with no need to ask first. If you need a shot of a specific module, a different size, a longer take or a quote for your piece, write to StudioZIO and it will come back the same day. · Boilerplate · A paragraph you can paste · StudioZIO Mastering Suite 2.1.1 is available in AU, VST3 and AAX plug-in formats plus a Standalone application. The release is a Universal macOS build for Apple Silicon and Intel, with AAX validated in Pro Tools. Nine stages share one gain structure: M/S engine, Saturation, Pink Match, Glue, Maximizer, Tone EQ, Clipper, Limiter and Output. Persistent metering includes FFT spectrum, vectorscope and LUFS/dBTP readouts. Pink Match matches material to a ten-band target over a 20-second learn pass. With the limiter and True Peak enabled, EXPECTED TP displays the requested ceiling minus a fixed detector reserve, an estimate rather than a measured output level. The limiter’s true-peak detector uses 16x reconstruction; the separate true-peak meters use 4x. A Quality Check System scores the output against standards-referenced metrics, reporting its own confidence and leaving genre-dependent figures unscored. It requires macOS 11 or newer, and installs from an Apple signed and notarized package with no account or registration. There is no Windows or Linux build. · No embargo, no approval over your edit, and no obligation to be positive. If it is not good enough, saying so is useful too. · Who makes it · StudioZIO · StudioZIO is an independent audio plug-in developer founded by Mert Erkan in Istanbul, and Mastering Suite is built by a working producer rather than assembled from a spec. Alongside it are Tempo Delay , also free for macOS, and ZIO MixRack, in development. · Contact StudioZIO Release notes

pages.text: Time Effect · v4.0.1 · Independent stereo delay, locked to the host grid. · Tempo Delay runs two fully independent delay buffers, each with its own note division, cross-channel ping-pong routing that throws repeats across the stereo field, and filtered feedback that reshapes every pass on its way round the loop. · Download for macOS See the routing AU · VST3 · AAX · Standalone Notarized Tempo Delay Release 4.0.1 Signal path in the order the audio takes Tempo 120.0 Left 1/8D Right 1/8 Tone 80–8k Fdbk 40 % Char Digital Width 100 % Mix 35 % Host grid 120.0 BPM L 1/8D · 375 ms R 1/8 · 250 ms Stereo echo field correlation +1.00 100 ms L / R Hear it first · The same passage, dry and delayed · Two renders of one performance, switched instantly so the playhead never moves. Both are matched to −12 LUFS integrated, because at different levels the louder one always wins and the comparison tells you nothing. · Tempo Delay · 1/4 and 1/8D, ping-pong Real render · matched −12 LUFS Hear it Dry Delayed Output Rendered through Tempo Delay 4.0.1 at 44.1 kHz. Both files measure −12.0 LUFS integrated with a −3.1 dBTP true peak, so the only difference you hear is the effect. · The interface · One window, nothing buried · The delay engine sits on the surface: sync, divisions, independent feedback per side, width and mix. Tone, modulation and routing are one tab away, never a nested page. · StudioZIO Tempo Delay 4.0.1 — Tone & Filters The Default Stereo Delay preset, running in the standalone app with real audio driving the meters and tempo sync off, which is why both delays read in milliseconds. These are the preset's values; the plug-in's own defaults are listed in the parameter guide below. Cropped to the GUI only. · StudioZIO Tempo Delay 4.0.1 — Advanced & Routing The same preset and the same audio-active session, with the complete routing and gain page visible. · Architecture · Six modules, one signal path · Every stage of the delay is addressable on its own, and every stage stays out of the way of the ones around it. · 01 Sample accurate tempo sync · Locks to the DAW transport clock or a manual project BPM, with sixteen note subdivisions per channel including straight, dotted and triplet. · 02 Independent dual L/R engine · Decoupled left and right delay lines. Run 1/4 on the left against 1/8D on the right, or free millisecond timing from 1 to 5000 ms. · 03 Ping-pong routing matrix · One toggle swaps the feedback matrix from parallel repeats to cross-channel bounces travelling across the stereo field. · 04 Analog modelled drive · A soft-clipping saturation stage sits inside the feedback path, moving from subtle harmonic warmth to hard analog crunch on the tails. · 05 Tone shaping feedback filters · Dual 12 dB per octave high-pass and low-pass filters run inside the loop, so every repeat is carved again as it decays. · 06 Mid/side stereo width · A width matrix from 0% mono collapse to 200% extra wide, for centred vocal throws or fully opened ambient tails. · Signal Flow Simulator · How the routing actually moves · Change the routing mode, tempo and note divisions to watch audio travel through both delay buffers, the cross-channel feedback matrix, the drive and tone stage, and the width matrix. · Educational interactive visualization This diagram demonstrates DSP signal routing mechanics: ping-pong cross feedback, delay times and feedback filters. Power · master_enable Default · On Range · Off / On · Purpose · Master DSP processing toggle with click-free crossfaded bypass. · How it behaves · Executes realtime-safe crossfaded bypass without digital transients. · What makes it different · Two delays, not one delay with an offset · Most stereo delays compute a single time and derive the other channel from it. This one runs two independent buffers, which changes what you can write rather than just how it sounds. · You can move the delay time while it plays · Reads land between sample positions using Hermite interpolation rather than snapping to the nearest one, and the modulation LFO moves those same interpolation points. Dragging a delay control bends pitch the way tape does instead of tearing. · Reads · HERMITE FRACTIONAL · 64-BIT FLOAT · Character modes change the circuit, not a curve · Digital, Tape and Analog are three processing paths inside the feedback loop rather than three EQ presets on the output. Digital stays full bandwidth, Tape warms the top end as it saturates, and Analog is darker on every pass. · Character · DIGITAL · TAPE · ANALOG · The repeats can stop behaving like repeats · Freeze locks the buffer and mutes new input so a tail sustains indefinitely. Reverse reads the same buffer backwards. Diffusion smears discrete taps through an all-pass network into an ambient wash, and ducking tracks the dry input envelope to pull the wet down while you are still playing. · Advanced · FREEZE · REVERSE · DIFFUSION · DUCK · The two modulators are deliberately out of phase · Left and right LFOs run at one rate with an adjustable phase angle between them, so the channels drift apart instead of wobbling together.
